title: Creatify SMP
description: A survival SMP built around Create and its addons. Build factories, fly ships, explore, and hang out with a chill group of players.
body:
# Creatify SMP

Creatify is a survival SMP built around the Create mod ecosystem. Whether you're deep in 
an automated factory, flying a hand-built aircraft across the map, or just exploring the 
world, there's always something to work on.

---

## What's in the pack

Create is the heart of it, and there are a lot of addons on top: Aeronautics for flying 
ships and aircraft, Railways for proper train networks, Big Cannon, New Age and Enchantment Industry for power and progression, Jetpack, Propulsion, 
and more. It's a lot, but it all fits together pretty well.

Beyond Create, the world itself is worth exploring. Nature's Spirit and TerraBlender make 
biomes feel fresh, and YUNG's overhauls mean structures like dungeons, mineshafts, and 
strongholds are way more interesting. Simple Voice Chat is also included, so you 
can just talk to whoever's nearby or make a group to talk to them from anywhere in the world instead of typing everything out.

Performance-wise, the pack runs Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, ModernFix, and a handful of 
other optimization mods. Big contraptions will always have some impact, but it holds up 
better than you'd expect.

---

## The server

It's a relaxed, community-first server. People mostly work on their own projects, but 
there's usually someone around to help or just mess about with. New players are always welcome, you can form teams and build nice things together too of course.

---

**Modpack:** NeoForge 1.21.1 - It will be installed automatically when you click play on the server page and it will update automatically to be in sync with the server mods
